query: Make a settings panel for my app: a slider for the volume, a switch for notifications and a combo box to pick the theme (System, Light, Dark). Put it in SettingsPanel.qml and show it from Main.qml. Every string is translated, and the panel works with a keyboard and a screen reader.
expected_behavior: Writes SettingsPanel.qml with a Slider, a Switch and a ComboBox, and a Main.qml whose window shows it
Wraps every string the user sees in qsTr
Names each control for assistive technology and keeps it reachable by Tab
Runs the checks and fixes what they find until ljos check, qml_lint and ljos audit report no Error

graders.name: content
graders.run: grep -q 'Slider' SettingsPanel.qml && grep -q 'Switch' SettingsPanel.qml && grep -q 'ComboBox' SettingsPanel.qml && grep -q 'qsTr' SettingsPanel.qml
